data.name: MAT1_001
data.value: Alright,[pause=10] this spot is better to talk.

data.name: MAT1_002
data.value: Huh?[pause=0] What was wrong with staying by the pond?

data.name: MAT1_003
data.value: Oh...[pause=0] Er...

data.name: MAT1_004
data.value: Bah...[pause=0] I may as well be honest with you.

data.name: MAT1_005
data.value: Do you remember earlier how I said nobody was supposed to be in {0}?

data.name: MAT1_006
data.value: Well...[pause=0] That includes me.

data.name: MAT1_007
data.value: I didn't want to linger around the pond because our town elder lives there.

data.name: MAT1_008
data.value: He forbids anyone from entering due to some supposed danger lurking inside.

data.name: MAT1_009
data.value: If he saw me by the entrance,[pause=10] he'd know that I've been in there again.

data.name: MAT1_010
data.value: That's why we stayed close to the trees when we left the pond.

data.name: MAT1_011
data.value: He has bad eyesight...[pause=0] So he can't see us if we use the trees as cover.

data.name: MAT1_013
data.value: I go there a lot because...[pause=0] it makes me feel like an adventurer.

data.name: MAT1_014
data.value: Ever since I was young,[pause=10] I've wanted to be an adventurer.

data.name: MAT1_015
data.value: The adventurers in the guild do so much important and exciting work.[br]I want to do what they do too!

data.name: MAT1_016
data.value: What!?[pause=0] You don't know what an adventurer is?

data.name: MAT1_017
data.value: Oh...[pause=0] right...[pause=0] I almost forgot who I'm speaking to.

data.name: MAT1_018
data.value: Adventurers are the best![pause=0] They do all sorts of amazing things!

data.name: MAT1_019
data.value: Exploring lands untouched for centuries,[pause=10] filled with hidden treasures...

data.name: MAT1_020
data.value: Helping Pokémon in need and bringing outlaws to justice...

data.name: MAT1_021
data.value: Forging friendships with Pokémon from all around the world...

data.name: MAT1_022
data.value: These are things I dream of doing![pause=0] Don't you think it's exciting too?[script=0]

data.name: MAT1_023
data.value: I'm glad you think so too!

data.name: MAT1_024
data.value: I've been wanting to sign up to apprentice at the guild so I could be an adventurer,[pause=10] but...

data.name: MAT1_025
data.value: I can't.[pause=0] You see...

data.name: MAT1_026
data.value: ...The guild doesn't allow anyone to apply for apprenticeship without a teammate.

data.name: MAT1_027
data.value: Adventuring is a team effort.[pause=0] It's a lot harder to adventure without a partner.

data.name: MAT1_028
data.value: Working as a team is a part of the culture too.[pause=0] Adventuring alone just isn't the same experience.

data.name: MAT1_029
data.value: My problem is...[pause=0] that...

data.name: MAT1_030
data.value: There's no one who's willing to form a team with me...

data.name: MAT1_031
data.value: So it's impossible for me to join the guild...

data.name: MAT1_032
data.value: I'm just a pretender,[pause=10] stuck exploring the local forest...

data.name: MAT1_033
data.value: Sorry...

data.name: MAT1_034
data.value: Anyway,[pause=10] that's why I was in {0}.

data.name: MAT1_035
data.value: If I can't join the guild and become an adventurer...

data.name: MAT1_036
data.value: ...at least I can go on my own little adventures in the forest.

data.name: MAT1_037
data.value: But enough about me...[pause=0] What about you,[pause=10] {0}?

data.name: MAT1_038
data.value: You woke up in a forest with no memory,[pause=10] transformed into a Pokémon...

data.name: MAT1_039
data.value: What are you going to do now?[pause=0] Do you have anywhere to go?

data.name: MAT1_040
data.value: Well...[pause=0] This may b-be sudden,[pause=10] but...[pause=0] C-could I ask s-something of you then?

data.name: MAT1_041
data.value: W-would you,[pause=10] um...

data.name: MAT1_042
data.value: Would you please form an adventuring team with me?

data.name: MAT1_043
data.value: It's just...[pause=0] After seeing how you handled yourself back in {0}...

data.name: MAT1_044
data.value: I thought that we would make a good team.[pause=0] You have a lot of natural talent for this.

data.name: MAT1_045
data.value: You also don't have anywhere else to go and you seem to like adventuring...

data.name: MAT1_046
data.value: So please...[pause=0] What do you say?

data.name: MAT1_047
data.value: Wh-what!? B-but...

data.name: MAT1_048
data.value: I really think we would make a great duo.[pause=0] We worked so well together in {0}.

data.name: MAT1_049
data.value: And with your amnesia,[pause=10] I'm worried what would happen to you if you had nobody to help you.

data.name: MAT1_050
data.value: We both would really benefit by sticking together.

data.name: MAT1_051
data.value: Really!?

data.name: MAT1_052
data.value: Thank you thank you thank you!

data.name: MAT1_053
data.value: We're going to make a great team![pause=0] We'll go on such amazing journeys together!

data.name: MAT1_054
data.value: Oh![pause=0] I'm getting ahead of myself!

data.name: MAT1_055
data.value: Before anything else,[pause=10] we need to go sign up at the guild!

data.name: MAT1_056
data.value: Top-class adventurers from all over the world meet there to find jobs and exchange news.

data.name: MAT1_057
data.value: Some Pokémon live in the guild and train together to become great adventurers.

data.name: MAT1_058
data.value: That's what we're going to do too!

data.name: MAT1_059
data.value: The guild is in Metano Town.[pause=0] We're actually on the outskirts of town right now.

data.name: MAT1_060
data.value: Ohhhh![pause=0] I can't contain myself any longer!

data.name: MAT1_061
data.value: C'mon![pause=0] To the guild![pause=0] Let's go let's go let's go!
